# JPR Electrical Contractors Pty Ltd

> Gold Coast based electrical contractor (QLD Lic 91131, ABN 98 698 175 316) leading with mechanical services electrical for HVAC/mechanical contractors from Brisbane through the Gold Coast to Byron Bay. AC/FCU/CU power, controls, MSSBs, VSDs, isolators, DDC/BMS interfaces and plant rooms, with commercial, civil/UG, high-end residential and solar as secondary services.
